name: rc3_validation_manifest

theorem_sets.name: sx3_known_deferred
theorem_sets.description: reproduction target: +4 RC2-deferred depth-2 candidates (NOT fresh delta)

theorem_sets.name: sx3_fresh_win
theorem_sets.description: SX3 fresh true depth-2 win (Set.ite_inter_inter); also present in holdout

theorem_sets.name: sx3_set_ite_holdout
theorem_sets.description: ALL fresh Set.ite/dite holdout cases (wins + no-wins); the genuine fresh-delta surface

theorem_sets.name: sx3_canonical_smoke
theorem_sets.description: non-Set canonical floor sample; expect 0 SX3 emissions

theorem_sets.name: sx3_set_cluster_cases
theorem_sets.description: general Set failures where broad ext/iff/subset families gave 0 true depth-2 wins

live_comparison_surface.description: Sets run live through the production harness for the RC2-vs-RC3 delta. Deduped by full_name across sets.
live_comparison_surface.note: sx3_fresh_win (Set.ite_inter_inter) is a 1-row subset of sx3_set_ite_holdout; runner dedupes by full_name.

canonical_floors.note: Run as REGISTERED theorem sets via eval_rollout_all.py --theorem-set. demo_v1 is a MIXED floor (includes Set.ite_univ); nat_defs_* are pure-Nat live non-Set off-gate evidence.

negative_controls.note: null-file_path rows cannot be opened live; the gate is name-substring 'Set.ite' so these can never emit SX3. Live non-Set off-gate is asserted by nat_defs_* floors + runnable Multiset control.

leakage_notes: Set.ite_univ (holdout): source proof is single-shot simp[Set.ite] -> expected SINGLE_STEP_DUPLICATE belonging to RC2, NOT a depth-2 win. Attribution must catch it.
Set.ite_inter_of_inter_eq (holdout): source uses an rw bridge -> source-specific risk; SX3 generic battery should NOT solve it (confirmed NO_WIN).
Set.ite_inter_inter is in both sx3_fresh_win and sx3_set_ite_holdout; deduped by full_name. Counted once as the fresh true win.
deferred4 are 'known' reproduction wins, reported separately and never counted toward the fresh-delta gate.
